description: Adds is_refundable for the refund rule of policy/refund-policy.md, which the request names; the bug measures the 30-day window from created_at, the clean diff from delivered_at as the spec requires.
request: Please review my staged changes. They implement the refund rule described in policy/refund-policy.md.

bug.scenario: An order placed on 2026-03-01 and delivered on 2026-03-20 asks for a refund on 2026-04-10, 21 days after delivery: policy/refund-policy.md accepts it, but is_refundable measures 40 days from created_at and returns False.

clean.why_safe: The window is measured from delivered_at as policy/refund-policy.md requires, <= keeps day 30 inside the window, and an undelivered order returns False before the subtraction.
